author: Zephyr I
title: AdamW+clip + warmup-cosine on double-step+AttnPool (48/96, d=5, ratio=0.6)
abstract: Test AdamW (wd=1e-5) with global grad clip(1.0) and warmup+cosine LR on the recommended double-step LN-ConvLSTM(48) + AttnPool backbone. Goal: check if schedule+wd+clip recovers/improves over 77.8.
